summary: End-to-end ML platforms handle the full lifecycle—data prep, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring—at scale, which is overkill if you only need to call a hosted model API (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, or Bedrock) for inference. You need a full platform when you're training or fine-tuning custom models, require reproducible experiments and governance, or must serve models in production with versioning, autoscaling, and monitoring. The landscape in 2026 is consolidating: hyperscaler suites (SageMaker, Azure ML, and Google's Vertex now folded into Gemini Enterprise) dominate when your data already lives in their cloud, while Databricks competes as a unified multi-cloud option and specialized tools like W&B, Modal, and DataRobot serve experiment-tracking, infra, and AutoML niches respectively.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker (SageMaker AI)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute-hour for training/inference instances, storage, and endpoints; no upfront fees. Savings plans available.
platforms.best_for: Teams already on AWS wanting a deep, service-oriented (if fragmented) MLOps suite with broad instance and framework support.

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go for compute, storage, and managed endpoints; no platform surcharge beyond underlying Azure resources.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem needing strong governance, responsible AI, and Azure OpenAI integration.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI (now part of Gemini Enterprise)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per node-hour for training/prediction, plus per-request pricing for generative/foundation models.
platforms.best_for: GCP-native teams wanting unified MLOps and tight access to Gemini and Model Garden foundation models.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based DBU (Databricks Unit) pricing on top of underlying cloud compute; tiered by workload type.
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting a unified, multi-cloud lakehouse that combines data engineering, ML, and governance via Unity Catalog.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-seat / usage-based paid tiers for teams and enterprise; self-hosted enterprise option.
platforms.best_for: ML/research teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and collaboration layered on top of any training stack.

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; managed versions offered via Databricks and other vendors.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open, framework-agnostic standard for experiment tracking and model registry without vendor lock-in.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription / contract-based (custom pricing, typically annual licensing).
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting automated end-to-end AutoML and governed model deployment for less code-heavy teams.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; enterprise editions (Driverless AI, H2O AI Cloud) via commercial subscription.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting powerful open-source AutoML plus enterprise GenAI with strong explainability and on-prem options.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second billing for CPU/GPU compute; free starter credits.
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting fast, serverless GPU infrastructure to run training and inference without managing clusters.

platforms.name: Amazon Bedrock
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per token / per inference, with provisioned throughput options for dedicated capacity.
platforms.best_for: AWS teams building GenAI apps on managed foundation models with fine-tuning, RAG, and guardrails without managing infra.

platforms.name: Hugging Face (Hub + AutoTrain + Inference Endpoints)
platforms.pricing: Free hub tier; usage-based Inference Endpoints and AutoTrain; Pro and Enterprise Hub subscriptions.
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source models who want the largest model/dataset hub plus managed fine-tuning and deployment.
